item.description:
Volna 1.0.5

  • Hold to talk. Hold your dictation key while you speak and let go to insert the text. A short tap still starts and stops dictation, and Esc cancels either way. Settings › Dictation shows how.
  • No more endings nobody said. In a noisy room, after a click or on silence, the recognizer sometimes added "Thank you." or a made-up phrase after your last word. Volna now listens for speech itself and gives the recognizer only your words; a "thank you" you actually say stays.
  • A tidier Settings window. Its window buttons sit inside the sidebar, as in the main window, with the sidebar button on the same row.
